summary.text: Cal Roberts is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 46, in office since 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
An investor, he previously served on the Draper City Council, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Roberts earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University and works as an investor, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he began his career on Wall Street at Credit Suisse advising on mergers and acquisitions, later worked in private equity and private credit, and has owned and operated small businesses.
He also said he served four years on the Draper City Council before joining the Utah House.
Roberts defeated incumbent Jeff Stenquist in the Republican convention on April 13, 2024, and in the Republican primary on June 25, 2024, for District 46.

In his survey he said he chairs the Government Operations Committee and the Commission on Housing and is vice chair of the Transportation committee, and he listed cost of living, economic growth and infrastructure as his policy priorities.
